definition: Chronic absence measures unduplicated K-12 students enrolled at least ten days who were absent at least ten percent of enrolled days. The published rate is retained without reconstructing its numerator or denominator.
attendance_definition: Attendance Rate is the percentage of days students in grades 1-12 were present during the school year, divided by their days in membership. The published percentage is retained.
glossary_locator: Comprehensive TPRS Glossary, page 9 of 57, Attendance and Graduation. The current retained definition describes reporting year2024-25; older published observations retain their exact period without an assertion of comparability.
